name: Birthday
short: Birthdays, upcoming birthday lists, and optional daily announcements.
description: Per-server birthday tracking for Red-DiscordBot. Members can set their birthday using [p]birthday 07/27/1985 or [p]birthday set 07/27/1985, optionally omitting the year, view upcoming birthdays, and remove their date. Admins can enable an announcement channel and set local timezone/time. Years and ages are not shown to others by default.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Stores month, day, optional birth year, and an age-visibility preference associated with each Discord user ID per server. Other members can view month/day, and age only when explicitly enabled. Members can erase their saved data with [p]birthday remove. Guild configuration stores announcement settings and the date of the last announcement. Supports Red's user-data deletion/export hooks.
install_msg: Birthday installed! Run [p]load birthday, then [p]birthday 07/27/1985. An admin can enable announcements with [p]birthday channel #birthdays.
